facts.director: Massimo Venier & Aldo Baglio & Giovanni Storti & Giacomo Poretti
facts.overview: While on the run from the police, an unlikely companionship blossoms between a funny con man who just broke out of jail, the bumbling cop whose car he seized at gunpoint, and a nitpicking civilian he unwittingly took hostage.
facts.title: That's Life

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can an escaped convict, the hapless cop he held at gunpoint, and an accidental hostage survive a chaotic police chase without driving one another mad?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After breaking out of prison, a con man hijacks a bumbling police officer's car and unwittingly ropes a nitpicking civilian along for the ride, launching an unpredictable getaway.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Light, funny road comedy with an easy pace, built around mismatched companions and accessible humor.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: This Italian comedy delivers steady laughs and lively odd-couple banter, carried by three mismatched personalities trapped together on the run.
